title: three_rpl_stacks fixture reconciliation: leaf announce relay after multicast DIO chain
description: Remaining fixture reconciliation from worker6-ehcn option (A) implementation (commit f447662504, receive.rs DIS response re-targets RPL_ALL_NODES): rpl_stack::tests::three_rpl_stacks_send_leaf_dao_via_preferred_parent still fails at tests.rs:1709 — root does not accept the leaf's announcement (expected AnnouncementAccepted with peer.iid == leaf). The chain: root multicast DIO -> relay joins ✓; relay multicast DIO -> leaf joins ✓; leaf announce -> relay accepts (relayed=true) ✓; root.receive expects AnnouncementAccepted { peer.iid == leaf } but fails. Likely the relay's gradient/route state needs the leaf registered via the multicast DIO before it will relay the leaf's announce (the old unicast DIO to leaf_addr established that link). Reconcile: either the test needs an explicit announce from leaf to relay first (mirroring the join chain) or the DIO-driven gradient update path needs review — NOT a production regression (the DIS-response re-target matches the admission contract; the test fixture assumed unicast DIO delivery). Diagnose against provision_leaf/gradient update semantics; do NOT weaken the assertion.
